title: PeerBrush — a free painting app for keeping AI edits on separate layers
author: Deftroyy
selftext:
Say you have a game background you like, but the sky and foreground are competing with your characters. In PeerBrush, you can ask a connected AI client to make a lighting pass on a separate layer. Then lower the opacity or paint on the layer mask yourself. If the lighting misses the mark, hide that layer and keep painting.



I’m the solo developer behind PeerBrush. I built it because I wanted to come back and adjust individual AI edits with familiar painting tools. It’s free and open source, and it can edit supported layered PSDs. You can connect your own compatible AI client when you want to use AI. The trailer shows the editor with AI-generated sample art. PeerBrush is developed with AI assistance.



Free downloads at [https://peerbrush.com/](https://peerbrush.com/)
